explanation: Fires almost only during the original (input) phase: 99.4% of activation mass. It never fires at t=0 and peaks at t=3-4. Two things drive it. First, the input token: 0 has the strongest lift (9x, a third of the mass), then o, j, f, h, 3 and r. Second, the earlier history: the rate is much higher when the sequence starts with s/t/v/q/w/u (first_tok lift 2.4-5x), and the top examples all start with s/t/v. It mostly fires on the first occurrence of the input token. It is nearly silent on the delimiter and in the copy phase. Combining the token set with the first-token condition gives dev F1 about 0.36 and mass recall 0.65. Precision is low (about 0.27): many matching steps do not fire, so the unit seems to read a graded hidden-state value that these conditions only approximate. The largest activations (0 at t=3-4 after an s/t/v start) are covered best, about 94% of the top quartile under the broader token set.
